briefdescription.para: This constructor intentionally left private, so that it is only called via "createUnresolvedDbgLabelRecord", which clearly expresses that it is for parsing only.
For use during parsing; creates a DbgLabelRecord from as-of-yet unresolved MDNodes.

detaileddescription.para: Trying to access the resulting DbgLabelRecord's fields before they are resolved, or if they resolve to the wrong type, will result in a crash.

briefdescription.para: Support type inquiry through isa, cast, and dyn_cast.
Records a position in IR for a source label (DILabel).
